formation_structure.blast_geometry: Ansel is sqrt(2) from Friston and opening Melantha, outside a 1.2-radius Ansel-centered blast. Ansel is sqrt(10) from Steward and three tiles from Hibiscus. Hibiscus and Steward are adjacent and can share a shell. Reciprocal coverage replaces V2's isolation, but does not establish survival through that shared burst.
formation_structure.damage_chain: Keep Steward through late approaches. Midnight supplies upper armor arts when his own blocked enemies permit. Returning Melantha supplies lower finishing damage while Friston retains blocking.
formation_structure.economy: Credit natural DP and only Fang's conditional grants at frames 570, 1320 and 2070. Credit no refunds. Post-payment balances are approximately 5.03 at Ansel 1321, 0.03 at Hibiscus 1681, 1.10 at Steward 2073, 8.03 at Beagle 2821 and 37.03 at returning Melantha 4141.
formation_structure.execution_scope: Timeline is a fixed candidate. Survival and clearance gates are acceptance checks, not an invented conditional executor. A failed gate falsifies the candidate.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Hibiscus [2,6] UP and Ansel [5,6] DOWN ordinarily cover each other, themselves, Steward [2,7], Fang [3,5] and Friston [4,5]. Neither ordinarily covers Midnight [1,5]; Ansel's forward extension supplies his scheduled recovery. Neither covers Beagle or central Melantha.
formation_structure.opening_replacement: Lancet remains excluded. Friston's former global-heal dependency is replaced by removing Ansel-centered collateral and providing two ordinary healing sources. Midnight's removed robot recovery is assigned to Ansel's extended windows. Hibiscus's late self-support is assigned to reciprocal Ansel coverage and repositioned boosts.

tactical_thesis: Retain eight IDs and replace V2's isolated recovery with reciprocal principal-medical coverage. Move Hibiscus to [2,6] UP; retain Ansel at [5,6] DOWN and Steward at [2,7] UP. Both medics now cover Ansel, Steward, Fang and Friston. Concentrate their first boosts on the northern artillery window. Preserve Melantha's live opening withdrawal, Beagle's lower-outer handoff and Melantha's central return. This is an unexecuted hypothesis: adjacent Hibiscus/Steward exposure remains a decisive survival test.
